purpose: Two natural product-research tasks on two public papers not previously used in the repository benchmark directory. Prepared independently before the next production freeze; not a known-answer or forced-routing test.
evaluation_scope: NEW_TO_REPOSITORY_BENCHMARK_TWO_PAIRS_ONLY. This is not a model-training holdout, statistical generalization study, expert certification, or evidence of product-wide superiority.
ground_truth_origin: No generated reference answer. Empty key_facts and forbidden_claims are not a gold completeness score. Review visible final answers and cited evidence against the pinned original PDFs. Keep this rubric, the protocol, registration and private review navigation out of model inputs.

protocol.treatment: Same service, corpus, question and generation settings; context_assistance_enabled=true, knowledge_skill_mode=auto, insight_mode=auto. Preserve actual source/card/input differences caused by shared production budgets.
protocol.bounds: Two questions, one repetition, two arms per question, at most four sequential Step 5 Preview requests. Production research output budget remains 8192 tokens per request; no experimental cap override. Proposed 50000 supplier-reported aggregate tokens is an observation-based soft stop, not a hard spending bound, pending parent approval. No retries, continuations, replacement answers or silent refill of incomplete pairs.
protocol.generation_controls: step-5-preview; temperature 0.1; same production request builder and retrieval settings in both arms; semantic=off. No private memories/history or LLM cache. Final values and a production fingerprint must be registered after code freeze and before any prepare or paid request.
protocol.privacy: Only these two public original PDFs may become the test corpus. Do not ingest review notes, rubric or generated reference answers. The material-preparation agent does not read credentials or call any model.

papers.title: A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory

rubric.rating_scale: Each dimension is rated 0-4 with claim-level evidence notes; weighted total is the sum of weight times rating/4. 0=absent or materially wrong; 1=major correction needed; 2=partly useful but substantive gaps; 3=usable with minor corrections; 4=well-supported and ready for the stated task. These are reviewer judgments, not automatic truth measurements.
rubric.single_answer_gate: Delivery complete; no critical factual, citation or feasibility error; method_fidelity and source_support each at least 3; weighted total at least 80. A high numerical score does not cancel a critical error.
rubric.critical_error: An unsupported or contradicted central claim that changes a recommendation, invents an experiment/result, misrepresents access or training requirements, or presents an untested product transfer as demonstrated benefit.
rubric.pair_interpretation: Preserve both answers and each gate outcome. Compare quality, provider token usage and end-to-end latency; distinguish measured paper results from proposed product changes. Activation, extra sources, citation count, keyword overlap and completion alone are not quality gains. Four responses cannot establish statistical or general superiority.
rubric.reviewer_disclosure: Independent developer/AI source review, not expert validation. Record whether arm labels were visible. Paper novelty here means absence from prior repository benchmarks, not absence from any model's pretraining.

questions.question: 我们在做一个会长期陪伴用户的个人助手，用户的工作、计划和偏好会不断变化。请结合 A-MEM 和 Zep，给团队写一份记忆模块设计建议：新增信息进来以后，怎样整理历史、处理变化，并在下一次聊天时用上；首版应该优先采用哪些设计，哪些先不做？结合论文里的验证说明理由，并给出一个小范围试用方案，帮助我们判断是否值得继续投入。
请根据 A-MEM 和 Zep，写一份面向产品团队的研究短报告，回答：比起保存聊天记录或摘要，主动组织记忆到底可能给长期私人助手带来什么价值，额外代价又在哪里？用两篇论文的方法和实验支撑判断，最后提出一个最值得我们验证的产品假设及可执行的小实验。结论要足够清楚，让团队能决定下一步把时间花在哪里。
